stem: Luis and his two brothers equally shared some waffles. The model shown represents the number of waffles Luis and his two brothers each received.
instruction: Complete the decimal equation to represent this model. Move the correct number to each box. Each number may be used more than once. Not all numbers will be used.
visual_elements: Model with three groups each containing 1 1/2 waffles.
Key showing 1 waffle equals the waffle image block.
notes: The problem requires completing a decimal division equation with draggable numbers based on the waffle model.
